race.description: Keith And Elaine Angus Memorial Mdn Trot
race.comment: WALKING ON WATER (6) settled in the leading division then went to the front and finished the race off okay when second last start over 1690m at this track, making it three minor placings in succession. Her last-start form is good enough to take out a race like this. SUFFARELL HILL (4) is back from a break of seven months and looks to be right up to the mark following a placing in a recent trial. Sure to prove hard to beat on her return. SYNTAX ERROR (3) is looming as a real threat after a better effort last start, finishing second at this track over 2190m. GYM QUEEN (2) is in the mix after turning in a better effort last start to finish third at this track over 2190m.
